items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: Bessie Smith was with the show.

ctx.x: And they tell me he's still living at home now, and he's kind of senile, you know. But the man was a great, great personality, and a great character, and a great drummer. You know, he was really something to see. He was a big attraction... He was an attraction. When he started coming down the street, it was beautiful to see him strutting, and with all the kind of pride in what he was doing... Oh, it was really beautiful.

Also, the Silas Green Show, which my father came to Jackson with the first time I saw him, when I was twelve years old... He was with Silas Green, and they had a fantastic show. Bessie Smith was with the show. In fact, she was with that show when she died.
